diagnostic.question: Does the proposed source-derived register mapping cover all16 outputs and retain pair grouping modulo finite commutation?
diagnostic.mechanism: Two local rows per parity class with four column pair exchanges; no total-shuffle-count reduction established
diagnostic.observable: Symbolic reduction trees/destination coverage and one positive binary32 wrong-reassociation counterexample
diagnostic.supports_if: All16 destinations and symbolic pairings match under stated finite assumptions; supports source grouping only
diagnostic.refutes_if: A missing/duplicate destination or changed reduction grouping appears
diagnostic.inconclusive_if: Grouping passes but actual inverse transport, compiler arithmetic, exceptional values,registers,dispatch exposure or speed remain unknown
diagnostic.limitations: No target FP32 exp/reciprocal/FMA/compiler/masks/synchronization execution; no native parity, instruction count or serving qualification Evidence revision: two exact source claims support mechanism applicability only; the original all-background plan and blocked receipt are preserved.
